# WTFGames

> WTFGames is an indie game studio building mobile games and desktop applications that entertain, challenge, and inspire.

The site lists the studio's games and applications with links to their store pages, plus a blog, privacy policies and product documentation.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/): Studio overview
- [About Us](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/about): Who the studio is, what it makes and its mission
- [Games](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/games): Catalog of games with App Store and Google Play links
- [Applications](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/applications): Catalog of desktop and mobile applications
- [Contact](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/contact): Business inquiries and social links

## Products

- [SpaceGlider](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/space-glider-2d/id1500827596): An interstellar runner game full of cosmic adventure
- [VirusHunt](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/virus-hunt/id1456015343): A fast-paced arcade game for kids about tapping falling cute viruses
- [LumaScope](https://apps.apple.com/ua/app/lumascope/id6759007715?mt=12): A modern IES viewer for macOS

## Blog

- [WTFGames Blog](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/blog/): Articles from the studio
- [How to open IES and LDT files on a Mac](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/blog/open-ies-ldt-files-on-mac/): Practical ways to open IES and EULUMDAT photometric files on macOS, with trade-offs

## Documentation and policies

- [Bakeneko Manual](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/bakeneko-manual-en.html): User manual for Bakeneko
- [Bakeneko Privacy Policy](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/bakeneko-privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy for Bakeneko
- [Ludorama Privacy Policy](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/ludorama-privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy for Ludorama
- [Ludorama Account and Data Deletion](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/ludorama-data-deletion.html): How to delete a Ludorama account and its data
- [LumaScope Privacy Policy](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/lumascope-privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy for LumaScope
- [WTFGames Privacy Policy](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/privacy): Privacy policy for the website
- [WTFGames Terms of Service](https://www.wtfgames.com.ua/terms): Terms of service for the website
